England primary maths · Year 6

Year 6 maths.
Stronger basics, one match at a time.

Fractions, percentages, ratio and algebra. Long division and multi-step calculations. Four-quadrant coordinates, area, volume, pie charts and mean. Use the academy alongside teaching and practical learning.

Build a Year 6 player

What does Year 6 practice focus on?

01

Fractions, percentages, ratio and algebra

02

Long division and multi-step calculations

03

Four-quadrant coordinates, area, volume, pie charts and mean

The map below names 63 practice families available for this year. Supporting skills can be revisited when a pupil needs them. Schools may sequence content differently within a key stage.

The Year 6 skills map

Number

Numbers to 10,000,000

Read, order and identify digit values through ten million.

Round to a chosen accuracy

Use suitable whole-number and decimal accuracy.

Intervals across zero

Calculate intervals and solve negative-number contexts.

Column addition · 5 digits

5 digits · mixed exchanges

Column subtraction · 5 digits

5 digits · mixed exchanges

Use flexible partitioning and known facts.

Order of operations

Use brackets and the order of arithmetic operations.

Estimate and justify accuracy

Use sensible rounding to check an answer.

Multi-step number problems

Choose operations and solve a multi-step context.

All tables mixed

All division facts

Use multiplication to help you divide.

Long multiplication

Multiply up to four digits by two digits.

Long division

Divide up to four digits by two digits.

Remainders and rounding

Interpret remainders as leftovers, fractions or extra groups.

Factors, multiples and primes

Use common factors, common multiples and prime numbers.

Fractions & decimals

Simplify and use common denominators

Reduce fractions and find a common denominator.

Order fractions above one

Compare fractions and mixed numbers.

Unlike-denominator calculations

Add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers.

Multiply fractions

Multiply proper fractions and simplify.

Divide a fraction by a whole number

Use equal sharing and simplify.

Fractions as division

Connect fractions, quotients and decimal equivalents.

Decimal place value

Read digit values through three decimal places.

Scale decimals by powers of 10

Multiply and divide by 10, 100 and 1,000.

Decimal multiplication

Multiply a value with up to two decimal places by a whole number.

Decimal division

Use written division with answers through two decimal places.

Percentages of amounts

Find percentages, missing amounts and equivalent representations.

Measure & time

Decimal unit conversions

Convert standard units using up to three decimal places.

Miles and kilometres

Use the approximate relationship 5 miles to 8 kilometres.

Decimal measure problems

Use operations with length, mass, capacity and time.

Area and perimeter relationships

Compare figures with equal area or equal perimeter.

Triangle and parallelogram area

Select and use an appropriate area formula.

Cube and cuboid volume

Calculate and compare cubic centimetres and cubic metres.

Shapes & space

Shape properties and construction

Use specified dimensions and angle properties.

Nets of solids

Recognise candidate nets and reason about folding.

Missing angles

Use triangles, quadrilaterals, regular polygons and line facts.

Parts of a circle

Name radius, diameter and circumference; use diameter = 2 × radius.

All four quadrants

Read and plot positive and negative coordinates.

Reflect and translate shapes

Transform shapes in a four-quadrant grid.

Charts & tables

Read pie charts

Connect sector angles, proportions and frequencies.

Construct a pie-chart sector

Calculate and draw a sector from given frequencies.

Read line graphs

Interpret, compare and calculate from a line graph.

Construct a line graph

Plot and join observations in the correct order.

Find and interpret the mean

Find totals, counts and missing values using the mean.

Ratio & algebra

Ratio and proportion

Compare relative quantities using multiplicative relationships.

Scale factors

Enlarge or reduce similar figures using a scale factor.

Unequal sharing

Share a total using a given ratio.

Use a formula

Substitute values into a simple formula.

Linear number sequences

Generate and describe an arithmetic sequence.

Missing-number equations

Solve simple equations using inverse operations.

Pairs of unknowns

Find pairs satisfying a two-unknown equation.

List all possibilities

Enumerate non-negative whole-number possibilities systematically.

Recall and connections

Times tables in Year 6

Consolidate all multiplication facts through 12 × 12 and related division. Keep reviewing facts while applying them in the wider curriculum.

Beyond a number answer

A grown-up records practical and reasoning work alongside digital practice.

  • Construct a shape from dimensions
  • Build a solid from a net
  • Construct data representations
  • Draw and transform a four-quadrant shape
  • Explain and justify a solution

How Year 6 promotion works

XP rewards effort and independent answers, but does not award a completed year. The academy checks broad independent coverage and later-day recall across this year’s families. Practical observations are recorded by a grown-up. A 12-shot promotion match then requires at least 90% independent accuracy, with the other goals still satisfied. Earlier facts remain available for review after promotion.

This is an in-game progression policy. It is not a DfE-approved pass mark, a diagnostic judgement or a guarantee that a skill will never be forgotten.
